summary: DMFI PAC, the electoral arm of Democratic Majority for Israel, endorsed Dalton as a "pro-Israel Democrat," citing his stance on the U.S.-Israel relationship. His platform urges avoiding "forever wars in the Middle East" and setting clear goals for military operations, but frames those concerns in terms of overseas spending returns rather than Palestinian rights. A campaign-claimed endorsement from 314 Action Fund, a hybrid PAC with documented 2024 UDP funding, reinforces the pro-Israel alignment.
